**Coaching Note (79 words):**

You had a critical king safety problem here! White won with Qe4+, forcing your king to move, then d7 pushes an unstoppable pawn to promotion. The key lesson: when your king is exposed far from home and your opponent has an advanced passed pawn, calculate forcing moves (checks especially) first. White's check both removes your king from the defense and loses time for your pieces to stop d7.
